name: Mayor's Youth Corps
what_you_do: A group of teens that lasts a year. They talk with the Mayor, learn how city government works and do hands on service for the community.
who_can_apply: Students in grade 9, 10 or 11 who live inside Tampa city limits or go to a high school there (home and virtual school students who live in the city can apply too). One year commitment.
deadline_text: The page links to a Class of 2027 application but gives no open or close dates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online MYC form. Then take part in a review and an interview. Contact Molly Biebel, Youth Development Coordinator, (813) 459-4002.
notes: The application form page would not open for the researcher, so the deadline is not confirmed. Age is not stated; grade 9 to 11 is the rule.
